title: Organization picker offers archived organization and Notes create is refused
surface: Settings organization picker and Notes side-panel
reproduction: Sign in as the authorized admin in a fresh extension profile.
Choose the approved throwaway organization, whose membership remains active although the organization was archived on 2026-09-22.
Open Notes and create a note.
expected: An archived organization is not offered as a place to work. A closed prior choice is cleared and the person chooses an open organization before any write.
actual: The picker offered the archived organization. Notes GET succeeded, but POST returned 403 (PostgREST 42501); the database log says the new row violated the Notes RLS policy.
severity: S2: a valid-looking organization choice makes all Notes writes fail
priority: P1: shared organization selection can break writes across features
root_cause: listMemberOrganizations resolves active membership IDs and reads iam.organizations without filtering archived_at. The selected organization is in iam.archived_org_ids(), and workbench.notes has a restrictive org_open_gate policy that correctly refuses its writes.
verification_status: Live cause proven; guarded organization tests passed 11/11, TypeScript compile passed, and fresh development build completed. Independent native retest remains pending.

transition_history.reason: Native Notes retry issued a real authenticated POST that returned 403.
Recorded the live archived organization gate, active membership, and picker query as the confirmed cause.
Source correction and focused guarded checks completed; native verification remains open.
